children: shares climbed 10% after the defense technology company delivered record fiscal first-quarter revenue and earnings that exceeded Wall Street expectations, according to a Wednesday press release.
Revenue reached $480.5 million, rising 6% from a year earlier and coming in $24.5 million above consensus. Adjusted earnings per share of $0.59 also topped the $0.25 estimate.

The company's Autonomous Systems business provided much of the growth, with sales increasing 21% to $346 million. Revenue from uncrewed aircraft systems rose 71% to $120 million, while sales from Space, Cyber and Directed Energy declined 21% to $134.5 million.
Gross margin improved to 26% from 21%. Adjusted EBITDA, however, decreased to $53.4 million from $56.6 million.
AeroVironment kept its fiscal 2027 revenue forecast at $2.125 billion to $2.225 billion and adjusted EPS outlook at $3.02 to $3.34. Both guidance midpoints remain below consensus.
The company expects roughly 55% of yearly revenue and about two-thirds of adjusted EBITDA during the second half.

title: AeroVironment Shares Jump 10% After Record Revenue Crushes Estimates
